Course Project · Thermodynamics

Geothermal Heat Pump Design

Selected a refrigerant and modeled a year-round geothermal cycle in EES for a 12.3 kW thermal load.

Course: Thermodynamics

Type: Individual project

Tool: Engineering Equation Solver (EES)

Problem

Design a geothermal heat pump system capable of providing both heating and cooling for a 12.3 kW thermal load throughout the year. Select an appropriate refrigerant and model the full thermodynamic cycle.

Approach

I evaluated five candidate refrigerants on thermodynamic performance, environmental impact (GWP, ODP), and safety classification. R-32 was selected for its favorable balance of high COP, low GWP, and good volumetric capacity.

The full vapor-compression cycle was modeled in EES (Engineering Equation Solver) with realistic component efficiencies and ground-source temperature profiles for year-round operation.

Results

  • Heating COP: 4.30
  • Cooling COP: 1.83
  • Design load: 12.3 kW
